result.summary: Both BLOCKERs fixed, nothing else touched. DEFECT A: replaced `grep -c "title:.*[Ee]ntit" docs/requirements.yaml` (real output today: 7, all false positives on 'identity' substring plus REQ-207's own title -- confirmed by independently running it) with `grep -n -B1 -iE "title:.*\bentit(y|ies)\b" docs/requirements.yaml`. Real output of the replacement, run this session: exactly 1 match -- `11714-  - id: REQ-207` / `11715:    title: Run Vortex's 4 simulation scenarios against Letflow (...entity list filter/page...) and report per-scenario findings` -- i.e. the sole match is REQ-207's own self-referential title (the -B1 id: line confirms it), not a claim by any other requirement. Section 4.1 now instructs the re-verifier to confirm the count is exactly 1 with id: REQ-207 on the preceding line as the 'no other requirement claims this subsystem' result, and to name/status-check any different or additional match. Section 4.3's evidence bullet (previously 'grep -c ... == 0') now reads the corrected command and its real 1-match/self-referential result. The underlying BLOCKED_ON_DEPENDENCY conclusion for AC4 is unchanged -- only the re-runnable verification command and its documented expected result were fixed. DEFECT B: §7 OQ-1 rewritten from an open question into 'OQ-1 -- RESOLVED/MOOT'. Independently confirmed this session: `git log main --oneline | grep -i REQ206` shows commit 2d068c79 ('REQ-206: SwiftRoute scenario execution (S7 simulation harness) (#767)'); `git merge-base --is-ancestor 2d068c79 HEAD` succeeds (exit 0) on this branch. Read the real shipped code directly (no git show against another branch needed): test/support/simulation/scenario_fixture.ex lines 40-41 show `@spec load!(path :: String.t()) :: Scenario.t()` / `def load!(path) do`; test/support/simulation/runner.ex line 45 shows `required(:via) => :api | :gui | :skip`. Both of §0.1's load-bearing dependencies are confirmed present. The design now states §0.1's fallback plan (ELIXIR-DEV stopping to ask ORCH for an inlined/duplicate YAML-load helper) is not exercised and does not apply -- ELIXIR-DEV should import/call ScenarioFixture.load!/1 and Runner/Scenario as normal already-merged REQ-205/206 dependencies with no fallback branching. Nothing else in the design was touched: §0 (except OQ-1's own paragraph in §7), §1-§6, §8, and OQ-2/3/4/5 are byte-identical to the prior iteration. Post-edit scan of the doc: 18 code fences, zero defmodule/defstruct/function-body matches (`grep -n 'defmodule\|defstruct'` and `grep -n '  def '` both empty) -- no implementation code introduced.
